what: What a bundle's own page states about buying it. The app keeps none of this today. The page's first state holds NO per-store stock or delivery estimate (no fulfillment key on this page; it is loaded later by the page itself), so 'in stock at his store' cannot be read from it; 'buyable online', 'discontinued', the per-order limit, the return window and the promotion's dates can.
